files_summary.state.json: Initial scenario state for the HelioDrive Vehicle Command Hub VehicleControlAPI (vehicle control system).
files_summary.README.md: Schema, lifecycles and business rules of this benchmark's datastore.

tool_schemas.name: activateParkingBrake
tool_schemas.description: Engages or releases the vehicle’s parking brake and returns the updated parking-brake state. It refuses requests without a mode, with a mode other than "engage" or "release", or that attempt to engage/release when the parking brake is already in that state.

tool_schemas.name: adjustClimateControl
tool_schemas.description: Sets the vehicle climate target temperature and optionally updates unit, fan speed, and climate mode, returning the updated climate settings. It refuses requests that omit temperature, specify an unsupported unit or mode, or set fanSpeed outside 0–100.

temperature.description: The temperature to set in degree. Default to be celsius.

fanSpeed.description: The fan speed to set from 0 to 100. Default is 50.

tool_schemas.name: check_tire_pressure
tool_schemas.description: Returns the current tire pressure reading(s) for the requested tire, or for all tires when omitted/"all". It refuses requests that specify an unknown tire value.

tire.description: Which tire to check. If omitted, checks all tires.

tool_schemas.name: displayCarStatus
tool_schemas.description: Returns the current vehicle status for the requested category (for example fuel, battery, doors, climate, headlights, parkingBrake, brakePadle, or engine). It refuses requests that omit option or provide an option outside the supported set.

tool_schemas.name: display_log
tool_schemas.description: Records or displays the provided log messages and returns the resulting log output/acknowledgement. It refuses requests that omit messages or provide messages in a non-array form.

messages.description: The list of messages to display.

tool_schemas.name: estimate_distance
tool_schemas.description: Estimates and returns the distance between two locations identified by the provided zip codes. It refuses requests missing either cityA or cityB, or where either value is not a valid zip-code string.

cityA.description: The zipcode of the first city.

cityB.description: The zipcode of the second city.

tool_schemas.name: estimate_drive_feasibility_by_mileage
tool_schemas.description: Estimates and returns whether the vehicle can cover the requested distance based on its available range/mileage. It refuses requests missing distance or where distance is not a positive number.

distance.description: The distance to travel in miles.

tool_schemas.name: fillFuelTank
tool_schemas.description: Adds the requested amount of fuel (in gallons) to the tank and returns the updated fuel level. It refuses requests missing fuelAmount, with a non-positive amount, or where adding that amount would exceed the tank’s 50-gallon capacity.

fuelAmount.description: The amount of fuel to fill in gallons; this is the additional fuel to add to the tank.

tool_schemas.name: find_nearest_tire_shop
tool_schemas.description: Returns the nearest tire shop based on the provided destination query, or based on the vehicle’s current destination when destination is omitted. It refuses requests when no destination is provided and there is no current destination available to search near.

destination.description: Optional location query (address/city/landmark) to search near; if omitted, uses the vehicle's current destination if available.

tool_schemas.name: gallon_to_liter
tool_schemas.description: Converts the provided gallon value to liters and returns the converted amount. It refuses requests missing gallon or where gallon is not a non-negative number.

gallon.description: The amount of gallon to convert.

tool_schemas.name: get_current_speed
tool_schemas.description: Returns the vehicle’s current road speed as reported by the vehicle state. This request is refused if the vehicle state is unavailable (for example, the vehicle is not connected or the speed sensor value is not currently being reported). It is also refused if any unexpected parameters are supplied.

tool_schemas.name: get_outside_temperature_from_google
tool_schemas.description: Looks up the outside air temperature for the provided location using Google as the source and returns the temperature in the requested unit. This request is refused if the location is missing, empty, or cannot be resolved to a unique place to query, or if the unit is not one of the supported values. It is also refused when the upstream temperature source cannot be reached or does not return a usable temperature for that location.

location.description: Location query (e.g., city or address) to retrieve outside temperature for.

unit.description: Temperature unit for the returned value.

tool_schemas.name: get_outside_temperature_from_weather_com
tool_schemas.description: Looks up the outside air temperature for the provided location using Weather.com as the source and returns the temperature in the requested unit. This request is refused if the location is missing, empty, or cannot be resolved to a unique place to query, or if the unit is not one of the supported values. It is also refused when the upstream temperature source cannot be reached or does not return a usable temperature for that location.

location.description: Location query (e.g., city or address) to retrieve outside temperature for.

unit.description: Temperature unit for the returned value.

tool_schemas.name: get_zipcode_based_on_city
tool_schemas.description: Returns a ZIP code for the provided city name. This request is refused if the city is missing or blank, or if the city name is ambiguous or unknown and a ZIP code cannot be determined. It may also refuse requests that include unexpected parameters.
tool_schemas.implementation:
def get_zipcode_based_on_city(city, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0098000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0098000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = datetime.datetime.utcnow()
    audit_name = "audit.json"
    audits = _load(audit_name)
    if not isinstance(audits, list):
        audits = []
    endpoint = "get_zipcode_based_on_city"

    if not isinstance(city, str) or not city.strip():
        latency_ms = int((datetime.datetime.utcnow() - t0).total_seconds() * 1000)
        audits.append({"ts": t0.isoformat() + "Z", "endpoint": endpoint, "status": "error", "code": "VALIDATION_ERROR", "latency_ms": latency_ms})
        _save(audit_name, audits)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "city is required and must be a non-empty string.")

    # Simple offline resolver; refuse ambiguous/unknown
    known = {
        "rivermist": "83214",
        "stonebrook": "74532",
        "maplecrest": "56108",
        "silverpine": "62947",
        "shadowridge": "71354",
        "sunset valley": "83462",
        "oakendale": "47329",
        "willowbend": "52013",
        "crescent hollow": "69238",
        "autumnville": "51479",
        "san francisco": "94016",
    }
    c = city.strip()
    key = c.lower()

    # Ambiguity heuristic: single word "valley" etc.
    if key in {"springfield", "san", "new york", "paris", "london"}:
        latency_ms = int((datetime.datetime.utcnow() - t0).total_seconds() * 1000)
        audits.append({"ts": t0.isoformat() + "Z", "endpoint": endpoint, "status": "error", "code": "VALIDATION_ERROR", "latency_ms": latency_ms})
        _save(audit_name, audits)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "City name is ambiguous; cannot determine a unique ZIP code.")

    if key not in known:
        latency_ms = int((datetime.datetime.utcnow() - t0).total_seconds() * 1000)
        audits.append({"ts": t0.isoformat() + "Z", "endpoint": endpoint, "status": "error", "code": "NOT_FOUND", "latency_ms": latency_ms})
        _save(audit_name, audits)
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Unknown city; ZIP code cannot be determined.")

    latency_ms = int((datetime.datetime.utcnow() - t0).total_seconds() * 1000)
    audits.append({"ts": t0.isoformat() + "Z", "endpoint": endpoint, "status": "ok", "code": None, "latency_ms": latency_ms})
    _save(audit_name, audits)

    return {"city": c, "zipcode": known[key]}

tool_schemas.name: liter_to_gallon
tool_schemas.description: Converts a volume in liters to gallons and returns the converted value. This request is refused if the liter value is missing, not a number, or is negative. It may also refuse requests that include unexpected parameters.

liter.description: The amount of liter to convert.

tool_schemas.name: lockDoors
tool_schemas.description: Locks or unlocks the specified door(s) and returns the updated lock state for those doors. This request is refused if the door list is missing, empty, or contains values outside the supported set, or if the unlock flag is missing. It is also refused if the vehicle is not in a state that allows door locking changes (for example, the vehicle is unavailable or the requested doors cannot be controlled at that moment).

unlock.description: True if the doors are to be unlocked, False otherwise.

door.description: The list of doors to lock or unlock. [Enum]: ["driver", "passenger", "rear_left", "rear_right"]

tool_schemas.name: pressBrakePedal
tool_schemas.description: Applies the brake pedal to the requested position and keeps it applied until you call releaseBrakePedal, returning the resulting brake state. This request is refused if pedalPosition is missing, not a number, or outside the allowed range of 0 to 1. It is also refused if the vehicle is not in a controllable state for brake actuation (for example, the control system is unavailable).

pedalPosition.description: Position of the brake pedal, between 0 (not pressed) and 1 (fully pressed).

tool_schemas.name: releaseBrakePedal
tool_schemas.description: Releases a previously applied brake pedal press and returns the resulting brake state. This request is refused if there is no active brake press to release or if the vehicle control state is unavailable. It may also refuse requests that include unexpected parameters.

tool_schemas.name: setCruiseControl
tool_schemas.description: Activates or deactivates cruise control and, when activating, sets the target speed and following distance, returning the updated cruise-control state. This request is refused if any required field is missing, if speed is outside 0–120 or not a multiple of 5, or if distanceToNextVehicle is not a valid number. It is also refused if the vehicle is not in a state that permits cruise control changes (for example, not moving or cruise control is unavailable).

speed.description: The speed to set in m/h. The speed should be between 0 and 120 and a multiple of 5.

activate.description: True to activate the cruise control, False to deactivate.

distanceToNextVehicle.description: The distance to the next vehicle in meters.

tool_schemas.name: setHeadlights
tool_schemas.description: Sets the headlight mode (on, off, or auto) and returns the updated lighting state. This request is refused if mode is missing or not one of the supported values. It is also refused if the vehicle lighting system is unavailable or the current vehicle state does not allow changing the headlight mode.

tool_schemas.name: set_navigation
tool_schemas.description: Sets the vehicle’s active navigation destination to the provided address string and returns the updated navigation state. It refuses requests without a non-empty destination, or where the destination cannot be parsed as a plausible address in the expected “street, city, state” form. It also refuses to set navigation when the vehicle is not in a state that allows route guidance (for example, navigation is unavailable or disabled).

destination.description: The destination to navigate in the format of street, city, state.

tool_schemas.name: startEngine
tool_schemas.description: Starts or stops the vehicle’s engine according to the requested ignitionMode and returns the updated engine/ignition state. It refuses requests where ignitionMode is missing or not one of the supported values (START or STOP). It also refuses state-incompatible transitions, such as starting when the vehicle is not allowed to start (e.g., immobilized or otherwise prevented) or stopping when the engine is already off.

ignitionMode.description: The ignition mode of the vehicle. [Enum]: ["START", "STOP"]

metadata.name: HelioDrive Vehicle Command Hub
metadata.description: A backend service that tracks a car’s live operational state and provides APIs to monitor and control functions like engine, doors, brakes, climate, lights, navigation, speed, tire pressure, fueling, and trip feasibility.
